images.caption: A replica of Badsha Mahommed Gool's ice cream cart at White Rocks in Broken Hill, New South Wales, Australia. Badsha Mahommed Gool was one of two people responsible for the Battle of Broken Hill, the only hostility to occur on Australian soil during World War I.

images.caption: Broken Hill, Picnic train, 1907 Picnic train with open trucks conveying men, women and children to an annual picnic believed to be one being held by the Manchester Unity Lodges at Penrose Park Silverton. According to a researcher, seven years later this same train was attacked by two Turkish patriots.
